newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rieter to acquire Brazil's Ello.
newsitem.headline: Rieter to acquire Brazil's Ello.

text.p: Rieter Group, maker of textile machinery and automotive supplies, said it was to acquire the Brazilian group Ello S.A., a supplier to Brazil's automotive industry, for an undisclosed price.
Ello is privately owned and is the leading manufacturer of interior trim as well as noise control and thermal protection components for the Brazilian vehicle industry.
Ello employs some 600 people in two plants and had sales of 75 million Swiss francs ($51.3 million) in 1996.
The acquisition is subject to Brazilian anti-trust authorities.
Ello supplies the Brazilian plants of Fiat Spa, Ford Motor Co, General Motors Corp and Volkswagen AG.
Two further plants are being planned by Ello.
Rieter Automotive Systems has had a presence in Latin America since 1996 with a plant in Argentina.
